Name: Qi Sprinklers
Author: UnkLegacy
Description:
Adds Qi Sprinklers to Stardew Valley.

[size=5]Install[/size]
1) Install the latest version of SMAPI.
2) Download this mod and unzip it into Stardew Valley/Mods.
3) Run the game using SMAPI.

[size=5]Features[/size]
1) Click on a sprinkler to force it to water instantly.
2) Adds "Qi Sprinklers" to the game. Qi Sprinklers combine the effects of Pressure Nozzles and Enrichers on Iridium Sprinklers.
- In order to use the fertilizer functionality, click on the Qi Sprinkler while holding any Fertilizer.

[size=5]How to use[/size]
You can configure activation on player action/placement in the config.json file. Both options are turned on by default. You can also adjust the range of the Qi Sprinkler if desired.

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
- Should work in both Multiplayer and SinglePlayer.
- Only works with vanilla sprinklers, none of the modded ones.
- Does NOT work with Prismatic Tools.
- SMAPI 3.9.1 and Stardew Valley 1.5.3

[size=5]Credits[/size]
- Heavily influenced by [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2428]Prismatic Tools[/url] by stokastic.
- Heavily influenced by [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7661]Sprinkler Activation[/url] by Blaxsmith.

[size=5]Known Issues as of 1.0.3[/size]
- Incompatible with Prismatic Tools

[size=5]Source[/size]
I do not guarantee any future updates, etc.
If you want to update or improve the mod, feel free to open a pull request.
Source lives on [url=http://github.com/UnkLegacy/QiSprinklers]GitHub[/url].
